reviews.text: Love the care they show their guest. I was greeted and welcomed when I walked in. Their plant selection was great, love the floor layout. Plants are full and healthy, good range from small to large. Check-out was quick, they walked my new plants to my car for me and even opened my car door for me. Top Tier service and plants. When I'm ready for some more new plant babies, I will be back.

My favorite greenhouse to shop! Super knowledgeable and always friendly. They helped me with determining what to do next with my plants for winter and then walked my purchase out and opened my door just as they always do. It’s nice to be treated like a queen every once in awhile!

Best garden center I’ve ever been to, hands down. Great selection of outdoor/indoor plants, pots, and fertilizers. Everything is healthy and glowing, and the staff is very kind. It’s a beautiful building!

data.summary: The data is for two distinct businesses. The highly positive 4.9 Google rating with 173 reviews is for 'Tropical Designs Dallas, TX,' a plant store/greenhouse. The contractor 'Tropical Designs' (pool builder/landscaper) has a poor 2.1 Yelp rating and a B- BBB rating. The positive reviews cannot be attributed to the contractor, making the overall review picture unreliable and likely misleading for a contractor evaluation.
fake_signals: Positive Google reviews are for a retail plant store, not the pool/landscape contractor
Mismatched business categories and services between review platforms
Lack of verifiable contractor-specific positive reviews
authentic_signals: Yelp rating is based on a low number of reviews, which can be volatile
BBB has a B- rating, indicating some business history
complaint_patterns: Insufficient data from contractor-specific platforms to identify patterns
data.discrepancy_explanation: Extreme discrepancy between Google Maps Local (4.9★, 173 reviews) and Yelp (2.1★, 7 reviews). The Google reviews are for a plant store/greenhouse, while Yelp and Google Maps HQ listings are for a pool/landscape contractor. This suggests the reviews are for two different businesses with the same or similar names, making the positive reviews irrelevant for assessing the contractor.
